contradiction_analysis.reservation_v2_js_semantics: AMBIGUOUS: 20–60 MAD — could be per-m² OR a severely wrong absolute range. Given context (similar pattern: Dépannage électrique from:150/to:350, Prise/interrupteur from:80), this appears to be PER_M2_ESTIMATION. However this is UNCONFIRMED — no source comment in reservation-v2.js confirms per-m² intent.

client_reachability.reservation_js_SERVICE_PRICING: ACTIVE_EXECUTED — used in renderStep1() and renderStep2() within window.FixeoReservation.open(). Displayed as "800–1500 MAD" range on service selection pills.
client_reachability.reservation_v2_js_SVC_PRICING_FB: ACTIVE_LOADED_NOT_CALLED_DIRECTLY — reservation-v2.js._getSvcPrice() tries window.SERVICE_PRICING first. Since reservation.js keeps SERVICE_PRICING in IIFE local scope (not window), window.SERVICE_PRICING is undefined. reservation-v2.js then falls through to SVC_PRICING_FB which contains 20–60 MAD.
client_reachability.which_wins: reservation-v2.js reads window.SERVICE_PRICING (undefined, since reservation.js does not expose it). Falls to SVC_PRICING_FB. So reservation-v2.js shows 20–60 MAD in its estimation block.
client_reachability.load_order: reservation.js loads first (line 314), then reservation-v2.js (line 316). Both defer. No explicit dependency.
client_reachability.concurrent_display: YES — Both render separate UI blocks on same page. reservation.js pill labels show 800–1500 MAD. reservation-v2.js estimation block shows 20–60 MAD. Client sees both simultaneously.

contradiction_analysis.p0_reason: Client simultaneously sees 800–1500 MAD (from reservation.js) and 20–60 MAD (from reservation-v2.js fallback) for the same Peinture intérieure service on 353+ production pages. A 40× price discrepancy in the booking flow damages pricing trust. Not safe to activate canonical engine until this is resolved.
contradiction_analysis.migration_warning: BEFORE canonical activation: (1) Remove or nullify reservation.js and reservation-v2.js Peinture ranges. (2) Replace with canonical per-m² pricing with minimum floor. (3) Ensure estimator UX collects painted_m2 from client. (4) Audit all other service ranges in both files for similar semantic mismatches.
